segments.ja434:1.1: Kāsāyavatthe sakuṇe vadāmi, duve duve nandamane [nandimane (sī. pī.)] carante;
segments.ja434:1.3: Kaṃ aṇḍajaṃ aṇḍajā mānusesu, jātiṃ pasaṃsanti tadiṅgha brūtha.
segments.ja434:2.1: Amhe manussesu manussahiṃsa, anubbate [anupubbake (ka.)] cakkavāke vadanti;
segments.ja434:2.3: Kalyāṇabhāvamhe [bhāva’ mha (sī. pī.)] dijesu sammatā, abhirūpā [abhītarūpā (sī. syā. pī.)] vicarāma aṇṇave.()[(na ghāsahetūpi karoma pāpaṃ)(ka.)]
segments.ja434:3.1: Kiṃ aṇṇave kāni phalāni bhuñje, maṃsaṃ kuto khādatha cakkavākā;
segments.ja434:3.3: Kiṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjatha vo anomā [abhiṇhaṃ (ka.)], balañca vaṇṇo ca anapparūpā [anapparūpo (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja434:4.1: Na aṇṇave santi phalāni dhaṅka, maṃsaṃ kuto khādituṃ cakkavāke;
segments.ja434:4.3: Sevālabhakkhamha [bhakkhimha (ka.)] apāṇabhojanā [avākabhojanā (sī. pī.)], na ghāsahetūpi karoma pāpaṃ.
segments.ja434:5.1: Na me idaṃ ruccati cakkavāka, asmiṃ bhave bhojanasannikāso;
segments.ja434:5.3: Ahosi pubbe tato me aññathā, icceva me vimati ettha jātā.
segments.ja434:6.1: Ahampi maṃsāni phalāni bhuñje, annāni ca loṇiyateliyāni;
segments.ja434:6.3: Rasaṃ manussesu labhāmi bhottuṃ, sūrova saṅgāmamukhaṃ vijetvā;
segments.ja434:6.5: Na ca me tādiso vaṇṇo, cakkavāka yathā tava.
segments.ja434:7.1: Asuddhabhakkhosi khaṇānupātī, kicchena te labbhati annapānaṃ;
segments.ja434:7.3: Na tussasī rukkhaphalehi dhaṅka, maṃsāni vā yāni susānamajjhe.
segments.ja434:8.1: Yo sāhasena adhigamma bhoge, paribhuñjati dhaṅka khaṇānupātī;
segments.ja434:8.3: Tato upakkosati naṃ sabhāvo, upakkuṭṭho vaṇṇabalaṃ jahāti.
segments.ja434:9.1: Appampi ce nibbutiṃ bhuñjatī yadi, asāhasena aparūpaghātī [asāhasenānupaghātino (ka.)];
segments.ja434:9.3: Balañca vaṇṇo ca tadassa hoti, na hi sabbo āhāramayena vaṇṇoti.
